notes: The ASV's note about another reading (Ish-hai) was read and set aside; the selected r00-base projection governs (rules 9, 38).
The italic *sons of* divides: *sons* completes the substantival numeral under rule 31 and *of* is the chain's own relation on the rectum under rule 19.
*who had done* is one `added` run standing together and doing one office, headed on *done* (rules 2, 20, 43); `rab` and `pəʿālîm` keep *mighty deeds*.
*in the midst of a pit* is rule 29's indefinite-rectum case: nothing is fronted, the article is `unrepresented`, the *a* is the rectum's own and the construct takes a supplied *the*.
